name: Metamagic Rod, Threnodic
body:
Aura strong (no school); CL 17th; Weight 5 lbs.

Price varies by specific type:

Lesser threnodic metamagic rod 9,000 gp
Threnodic metamagic rod 32,500 gp
Greater threnodic metamagic rod 73,000 gp

DESCRIPTION

The wielder can cast up to three spells per day that are affected as though by the Threnodic Spell feat.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Rod, Threnodic Spell

Cost varies by specific type:

Lesser threnodic metamagic rod 4,500 gp
Threnodic metamagic rod 16,250 gp
Greater threnodic metamagic rod 36,500 gp
